feature: Trigger events and filters that do not exist yet
description: Add trigger events and filters for cycling (including the first time each turn), rolling dice, copying or casting a spell, Adventure spells, becoming untapped, unlocking a Room, damage to a battle, noncombat damage to an opponent, damage to the enchanted player, and valiant targeting by your own sources.

feature: Game-state conditions and values
description: Add conditions and values for distinct party classes and distinct powers, per-defender land and creature checks, creature cards in your graveyard, the cast-from-graveyard and committed-a-crime checks, the convoke count, greatest power fixed at cast, and the gap between the most lands and a player's own.

feature: Per-player scope and chooser on effects
description: Add player routing and chooser fields so effects can act for or be chosen by another player: each opponent searching or scrying, per-opponent choices and sacrifices, an opponent choosing a card, friend-or-foe choices, per-owner graveyard shuffles and the active player's optional counter and mana.

feature: Rule statics and permissions that do not exist yet
description: Add rule statics and permissions for blocking and attacking restrictions (greater-power blockers, only haste blockers, at most one blocker, can't attack, skipped combat), untap prevention for enchanted or controlled permanents, protection from a chosen creature type, and cascade grants.

feature: Ability cost forms
description: Add cost forms: variable sacrifice and discard counts, discard costs filtered by card type or subtype, Exert as an activation cost, reveal-a-card or pay alternatives, a chosen-on-resolution tap cost, cycling and retrace cost substitution, and X storage-counter removal paired with mana produced.

feature: Missing keyword mechanics (suspend, buyback, myriad, madness, foretell)
description: Add keyword mechanics and grantable abilities the schema lacks: madness, echo, delve, freerunning, encore with attack requirements, harmonize, flashback granted to a graveyard card, and fear and landwalk.

feature: Replacement effects that do not exist yet
description: Add replacement effects for exile instead of dying on a single object, damage prevention and redirection, a first-draw replacement, a draw turned into a discard, umbra armor, and reflexive triggers tied to a replacement.

feature: Modern keyword actions (venture, ring tempts, suspect, crime)
description: Add modern keyword actions: clash, the Ring tempting you, venture, day and night, collect evidence, opening an Attraction and the clash-gated follow-ups.
cards: Now for Wrath, Now for Ruin!

feature: Selector predicates in targets and statics
description: Add selector and target kinds for blocked creatures, creatures dealt damage this turn, same name as a chosen target, spells with an Adventure, tokens relative to their controller, creatures put into a graveyard this turn, and sacrifice filters that include lands.

feature: Amounts produced by the previous effect or event
description: Add Values and references that read amounts and objects from earlier in the resolution or from the event: life gained by a trigger event, the toughness of a sacrificed or triggering creature, the mana value of an exiled card, the token just created, a chosen creature's own power, and whether a returned permanent was a token.

feature: Variable-count target slots and chosen-count value
description: Add target slots, selectors and counts that accept an announced X or a state-derived number, including X on activated abilities, mana value bounds taken from a Value, up-to-one graveyard targets and distributed counters across chosen creatures.

feature: Random, guessed and hidden-information choices
description: Add voting with a separate effect per vote, random graveyard returns, random hand reveals, life bidding, two-pile separation and looking at hidden cards or face-down creatures.

feature: Reveal/exile/mill-until loops with leftovers handling
description: Add reveal-until, look-at-top and mill-until ops with multi-pick battlefield destinations, a distinct destination for each remaining card, historic and mana value filters, and suspend-style exile with counters.

feature: Optional choices and if-you-do follow-ups
description: Add may-decline forms and follow-up effects gated on whether an optional action happened, including optional mill, sacrifice-or-otherwise branches, up-to picks and conditional follow-ups after a look at the top cards.

feature: Cast a card from other zones with a rider
description: Add cast and play permissions with a rider: exile-play durations beyond end of turn, plays gated on a later sacrifice, free casts bounded by a counted value and mayhem from the graveyard.

feature: Put onto battlefield tapped and attacking or attached
description: Add token and return forms that enter tapped and attacking or attached: tapped-and-attacking copies, mobilize tokens, an added subtype on returned creatures and optional equipment attachment.

feature: Stack, spell copy and spell-targeting effects
description: Add stack interaction: a spell copy that keeps its original targets, putting a countered spell on the bottom of its library and a stack filter for spells together with abilities.

feature: Ability removal and base power/toughness overrides
description: Add continuous effects that grant all creature types until end of turn and set base power and toughness from a state-derived value.

feature: Delayed end-step effects on created or returned objects
description: Add delayed triggers that carry remembered objects or give an object to another player: a return at the next upkeep that remembers the sacrificed card and a gift to an opponent at the next end step.

feature: Life totals and game-result effects
description: Add effects that exchange or set life totals and effects that make a player win the game.

feature: Control exchange effects
description: Add effects that exchange control of permanents between players, with a chosen count and no end-of-turn limit.

feature: Turn-history conditions
description: Add per-turn history conditions such as an artifact entering the battlefield under your control this turn.

feature: Copy and become-a-copy effects with added types or abilities
description: Add become-a-copy forms that keep an extra ability of the copying permanent.

feature: one-off
description: Single cards with their own missing feature: removing any counter kind, one-shot cost reduction, Equipment attachment to a created token, putting a permanent on the library bottom, sacrificing unchosen lands, damage to a player or planeswalker, per-controller token creation, turning a face-down permanent face up, X read at cast, Pilot tokens, mass sacrifice with searches, returning with a finality counter and controlling another player's turn.
